items.source: The default implementation simply returns null. Note that the default message may be identical to the primary message code (MessageSourceResolvable.getCodes()), which effectively enforces AbstractMessageSource.setUseCodeAsDefaultMessage(boolean) for this particular message.
items.translation: 默认实现仅返回 null。请注意，默认消息可能与主消息代码（MessageSourceResolvable.getCodes()）相同，这实际上为该特定消息强制实施了AbstractMessageSource.setUseCodeAsDefaultMessage(boolean)。

items.source: To be overridden in more specific subclasses, potentially including the resolvable content through resolvableToString().
items.translation: 由更具体的子类重写，可能包括通过 `resolvableToString()` 解析的内容。

items.source: Spring's default implementation of the MessageSourceResolvable interface. Offers an easy way to store all the necessary values needed to resolve a message via a MessageSource.
items.translation: Spring 对 `MessageSourceResolvable 接口的默认实现。提供了一种简单的方法来存储所有通过 `MessageSource 解析消息所需的值。
